content: If additional therapeutic intervention is required, the use of SGLT2 inhibitors or GLP-1 receptor agonists should be considered as part of the treatment strategy. In cases where the current treatment regimen has already been optimized, it is recommended to reassess the patient's condition to determine whether incorporating the alternative drug class (either SGLT2 inhibitors or GLP-1 receptor agonists) would provide a net clinical benefit, taking into account the balance of potential benefits and associated risks.
